description: This file defines the MigrationHubClient class for AWS Migration Hub, including method signatures for various synchronous and asynchronous AWS SDK operations related to migration management.

classes.name: MigrationHubClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Migration Hub service, providing methods to interact with the service.

methods.name: associateCreatedArtifact
methods.description: Associates a created artifact with a migration task.

methods.name: associateCreatedArtifactAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a created artifact with a migration task.

methods.name: associateDiscoveredResource
methods.description: Associates a discovered resource with a migration task.

methods.name: associateDiscoveredResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a discovered resource with a migration task.

methods.name: associateSourceResource
methods.description: Associates a source resource with a migration task.

methods.name: associateSourceResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a source resource with a migration task.

methods.name: createProgressUpdateStreamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a progress update stream.

methods.name: deleteProgressUpdateStreamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a progress update stream.

methods.name: disassociateCreatedArtifact
methods.description: Disassociates a created artifact from a migration task.

methods.name: disassociateCreatedArtifactAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates a created artifact from a migration task.

methods.name: disassociateDiscoveredResource
methods.description: Disassociates a discovered resource from a migration task.

methods.name: disassociateDiscoveredResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates a discovered resource from a migration task.

methods.name: disassociateSourceResource
methods.description: Disassociates a source resource from a migration task.

methods.name: disassociateSourceResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates a source resource from a migration task.

methods.name: notifyMigrationTaskStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously notifies migration task state change.
